import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to, cap, cost, rev;
        Edge() {}
        Edge(int t, int c, int co, int r) {
            this.to = t;
            this.cap = c;
            this.cost = co;
            this.rev = r;
        }
    }

    static class MinCostMaxFlow {
        int V;
        int[] H, dist, preV, preE;
        List<Edge>[] G;

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        void initialize(int n) {
            V = n;
            G = new ArrayList[V + 1];
            for (int i = 0; i <= V; i++) {
                G[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
            H = new int[V + 1];
            dist = new int[V + 1];
            preV = new int[V + 1];
            preE = new int[V + 1];
        }

        void addEdge(int from, int to, int cap, int cost) {
            G[from].add(new Edge(to, cap, cost, G[to].size()));
            G[to].add(new Edge(from, 0, -cost, G[from].size() - 1));
        }

        int computeMinCost(int s, int t, int flow) {
            int totalFlow = 0, totalCost = 0;
            Arrays.fill(H, 0);
            while (flow > 0) {
                PriorityQueue<int[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingInt(a -> a[0]));
                Arrays.fill(dist, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                dist[s] = 0;
                pq.offer(new int[]{0, s});
                while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                    int[] current = pq.poll();
                    int v = current[1];
                    if (dist[v] < current[0]) continue;
                    for (int i = 0; i < G[v].size(); i++) {
                        Edge e = G[v].get(i);
                        if (e.cap > 0 && dist[e.to] > dist[v] + e.cost + H[v] - H[e.to]) {
                            dist[e.to] = dist[v] + e.cost + H[v] - H[e.to];
                            preV[e.to] = v;
                            preE[e.to] = i;
                            pq.offer(new int[]{dist[e.to], e.to});
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (dist[t] == Integer.MAX_VALUE) break;
                for (int i = 0; i <= V; i++) H[i] += dist[i];
                int d = flow;
                for (int v = t; v != s; v = preV[v]) {
                    d = Math.min(d, G[preV[v]].get(preE[v]).cap);
                }
                flow -= d;
                totalFlow += d;
                totalCost += d * H[t];
                for (int v = t; v != s; v = preV[v]) {
                    Edge e = G[preV[v]].get(preE[v]);
                    e.cap -= d;
                    G[v].get(e.rev).cap += d;
                }
            }
            return totalCost;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        MinCostMaxFlow minCostFlow = new MinCostMaxFlow();
        int size = n * (n + 55) + 2;
        minCostFlow.initialize(size);

        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int u = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
            minCostFlow.addEdge(0, u, 1, 0);
        }

        List<int[]> edges = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int u = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int v = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            edges.add(new int[]{u, v});
        }

        int target = n * (n + 55) + 1;
        for (int t = 0; t < n + 54; t++) {
            for (int[] e : edges) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= k; j++) {
                    minCostFlow.addEdge(e[0] + t * n, e[1] + (t + 1) * n, 1, c + d * (j * 2 - 1));
                    minCostFlow.addEdge(e[1] + t * n, e[0] + (t + 1) * n, 1, c + d * (j * 2 - 1));
                }
            }
            for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
                minCostFlow.addEdge(i + t * n, i + (t + 1) * n, k, c);
            }
            minCostFlow.addEdge(1 + t * n, target, k, 0);
        }

        int result = minCostFlow.computeMinCost(0, target, k);
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
